zh-CN.title: 模型构筑个人环境的三个原则
zh-CN.description: 三项原则分别说明模型如何构筑环境、介绍概念和帮助本人配置环境。

meaning: 让本人凭日常经验就能看懂环境怎样使用、能用来做什么。
需要精确定义、计算或证明时，再引入相应的形式语言。
用日常语言直接说清一个概念指什么。
保留决定含义的区别和条件，省去重复解释和琐碎限定。
把布局、关系和变化画出来，让本人直接看见。
文字标明必要的名称和条件，本人就能对着配置作判断。

en.title: Three principles for building a personal environment
en.description: The principles address building an environment, explaining a concept, and helping someone configure their own environment.

meaning: Make the purpose and use of the environment apparent through everyday experience.
Introduce formal language when a precise definition, calculation, or proof calls for it.
Say directly what the concept means in everyday language.
Keep distinctions that matter to its meaning. Omit repetition and incidental caveats.
Show layouts, relationships, and changes so the person can see them directly.
Use words for the names and conditions needed to judge the configuration.
